title: Close the price question first
path_a: Publish nothing that calls a number a price: strip the close column to blanks and keep the ledger mirror in a separate, labelled table.
path_b: Keep the current labelling (mirror vs quote) and record the policy in DECISIONS.md without buying anything.
path_c: Acquire an authenticated quote feed and re-run every gate against real closes.
cost: A: no cost, some rework · B: no cost · C: a subscription
risk: A discards usable research signal · C spends money before the signal is shown to exist
gate_cleared: F-44 becomes answerable; G1 still fails until a real quote is held
source_label: NFL.com scores (the settlement the closes would be graded against)

title: Capture the game-day report window
path_a: Extend the existing availability workflow with a Sunday T-100m/T-60m capture of the official pre-game report, storing the raw page and its hash.
path_b: Wait for the Game Book workflow (another session's scope) and derive inactives from the Game Book instead.
path_c: Both, with the two sources cross-checked and conflicts flagged rather than reconciled by hand.
cost: machine time and one workflow file; no purchase
risk: a third capture source means a third way to be wrong; conflicts must be published, not averaged
gate_cleared: unblocks RX-16, which RX-40 and RX-41 wait on

title: Make the derived injury table read the newest capture
path_a: Point the derived Week 10 table at the newest dated capture and let the build fail if a club's row count drops without a transaction to explain it.
path_b: Leave the derived table as a dated sample and publish the capture as the source of record, with the difference stated on the page.
cost: one input path change plus an expected-count assertion
risk: an expected-count rule can shout at a legitimate source change; the exception list matters
gate_cleared: removes the 347-against-258 row gap that RX-23 records

title: Decide storage and terms before more data accumulates
path_a: Keep captures in the public repository and read the terms before publishing anything derived from a club page.
path_b: Move raw captures to release assets or a private store, keep the site to derived analysis, and add a freshness alert.
path_c: Do nothing until a legal read is available; accept the drift risk in the meantime.
cost: one repository change plus a small alerting job
risk: Path C leaves the site as the only store, which is the failure mode the brief flags
gate_cleared: RX-31 and RX-32; also makes RX-47's 'no manual input' claim stronger

title: Grow the availability corpus forward, not backward
path_a: Start a dated pre-kickoff capture of the report per club and let it accumulate for a season; no backtest of availability claims until then.
path_b: Reconstruct history from archive pages that carry no publication time, and label every such row as ambiguous.
path_c: Skip availability as a model input and keep it as a published diagnostic.
risk: Path B's ambiguity is exactly the lookahead the brief forbids; Path C is honest but slow
gate_cleared: one season (about 321 games' worth of captures) makes RX-33 runnable

title: Resolve the depth-order source club by club
path_a: Verify the club chart route for all 32 clubs and record which clubs cannot be parsed, rather than treating an image as an absence of depth.
path_b: Use snap share as the ordering everywhere, once a Game Book or play-by-play source is merged.
path_c: Restrict every depth feature to the clubs whose charts are verified, and say so on each row.
cost: a coverage audit per club; route B depends on another session's merge
risk: a partial chart route silently treats unparsed clubs as healthy
gate_cleared: RX-37 and the depth half of RX-06
source_label: club depth-chart pages (one of 32; the audit covers all)

title: Turn the path picker into a recorded decision
path_a: Leave the picker as a browser preview; the owner writes the chosen path into DECISIONS.md by hand.
path_b: Add a reviewed path where a chosen selection is submitted as a pull request against the register, so a decision is auditable and reversible.
cost: a small export format plus one manual commit per decision
risk: Path C would let a browser click change a published decision record — refused by the evidence policy
gate_cleared: RX-62's 'selection is not recorded' limit; RX-57 if the decision is the price policy
source_label: GitHub Pages (a static site cannot write a decision back)

title: Retire or resolve the brief's private identifiers
path_a: Ask the brief author for the mapping (VR-*, VQ-*, SG-*, the 136-game log) and restate the affected rows against named artefacts.
path_b: Restate each claim in repository terms now, and treat the identifiers as prose.
path_c: Leave them as unresolvable flags, as F-48 does.
cost: one exchange with the brief author
risk: Path B risks silently substituting a different claim for the one made
gate_cleared: RX-20 and RX-44 stop being not-reproducible, or are formally closed
source_label: NFL.com transactions (the page several such claims rest on)
